hook: IIIT-H students turn any webpage into *sign language*
hook_b: IIIT-H students turn any webpage into *sign language*
tldr: Third-year BTech students Masthan Sharif Shaik and Mohammed Raza at IIIT Hyderabad's CVIT built SignPlug, a browser plugin where a 3D avatar signs highlighted text in ISL. Tests showed signs understood in about 89% of sentences.

beats.what: IIIT-H students built a low-cost browser plugin that signs web text in Indian Sign Language.
beats.why: Websites offer captions and screen readers, but almost none show content in sign language, the students said.
beats.care: Words without a sign are finger-spelled; the avatar has no facial expressions yet, which ISL grammar uses.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: TOI (Nov 19): the research is accepted at ICVGIP 2026 in Kolkata in December.

facts.t: Deaf and hard-of-hearing signers understood the avatar in about *89%* of sentences.
